review_policy.label_error_meaning: The scoped present/not_observed assessment is not supported by the supplied pseudo-C.
review_policy.evidence_error_meaning: The target finding does not expose the target-CWE relation needed to teach or justify the assessment.

decisions.notes: CWE-126 not_observed target cites only a benign message and omits the dataGoodBuffer selection that bounds the subsequent indexed read.
CWE-122 not_observed target cites only source initialization and omits the 0x2c allocation-to-copy-size relation.
CWE-789 not_observed target cites socket error checks instead of the visible 100-element upper bound applied before allocation.
CWE-121 present target cites only constant-index NUL initialization and omits the 99-element source initialization followed by concatenation into a 50-element destination.
CWE-121 not_observed target cites only one terminator write and omits the 49-element source bound and concatenation operation.
CWE-78 not_observed target cites loop initialization and popen but omits the pair-unique constant command-buffer assignments that distinguish it from externally influenced input.
